posts.text:
Eight months after discovering highly reactive lead waste at an ammunition plant in southeastern Iowa, the U.S. Army plans to do what it says is the only safe option: blow up the barrels.

But the detonation was postponed after an outcry from residents.

하지만 주민들의 항의로 폭발은 연기됐다.
